comment: T3 excluding zero is not driven by leverage or single days (dropping top 3 days raises slope, CI still excludes 0). T3 differs from T0 by swapping the regressor; start-temp is a noisier proxy for in-drive pack temperature (r=0.90) so it absorbs less of the temperature effect and months picks up more via the temperature-months link. It is a specification-dependent result, not evidence of a trend: 5 of 6 specs include zero; T3 is the only one using a key-on measure (thermal state at start, possibly reflecting soak/rest state). Not corrected for 6-spec multiplicity.
